key.name: update-delay
key.description: The panel color is normally updated on the next frame after a focus change, or as soon as a window animation is complete. This is the delay in milliseconds after a triggering event (focus change, resize, workspace switch) for an additional update that catches what those miss, e.g. a workspace switch animation or an app redrawing late. It's also the longest time to wait for a window animation to complete.

key.name: poll-fallback-enabled
key.description: Periodically re-check the color even without a triggering window event, to catch content-only changes (e.g. a web page finishing loading) that don't fire any window-manager signal. This wakes the system every few seconds, which costs some battery life.

key.name: accent-color-enabled
key.description: Also set the system accent color (GNOME 47 and later) to the preset closest in hue to the panel color. Gray colors keep your own accent color, which is restored when the extension is disabled.
